profile.headline: Passionate Software Architect/Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Developer, Service Delivery and Cloud
profile.summary:
- Summary - 

•	Passionate software architect/engineer with over 15 years of industry experience. 
•	In-depth knowledge of Java, XML, EDI, J2EE, Web, Database and mission critical software development in Agile process
•	Highly effective communicator, fast learner and great trouble shooter
•	Self-motivated and disciplined IT professional and great mentor
•	Innovative technologist with proven leadership skills




- Technical Expertise -

•	Fluent in Java, XML, J2EE, SOA, PL/SQL, Linux, UML, HTML, JavaScript
•	Experienced with C, C++, Shell Scripting
•	Strong Knowledge in DB Design/Tuning, Design Patterns, Refactoring and Code Optimization
•	Strong Knowledge in CVS , SVN , GIT  
•	Knowledgeable in Payment Processing, PCI, SSL, Security
•	Strong knowledge of J2EE frameworks like Struts, Hibernates
•	Strong knowledge of EDI, XML and Transformation Technologies
•	Strong knowledge of Test Driven Development and Automated Testing
•	Strong knowledge of Eclipse and Ant
•	Familiar with Maven and UI technologies like CSS/Ajax

positions.title: Staff Software Developer, Service Delivery and Cloud
Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Architected and lead Metadata Driven Payment Processor Management project for PayFlow 
-	Lead the design, implementation and maintenance of PayFlow Reporting Service.
-	Lead SQL and DB tuning efforts for mission critical and huge database working closely with DBA and Operation groups for PayFlow Apps Team
-	Heavily involved in resolving critical performance related production issues.
-	Played a critical role in project planning and lead design discussions
-	Designed and implemented Continuous Integration Testing Framework  
-	Mentored developers on best design practices, refactoring and Unit Testing.

-	Keywords: Apache, WebLogic, Java, J2EE, Struts, Hibernate, XML/RPT Web service, SSL, Security, Oracle, Quartz

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for iWay Transformer engine which is one of the core components of iWay Service Manager.

iWay Transformer can execute far more sophisticated transformations than most ESBs. 
Unlike basic XSLT engines that handle only XML-to-XML transformations, 
iWay Transformer can translate XML to virtually any format and from any format to XML. 

Designed, implemented and maintained the followings. 

1. iWay Transformer engine.
2. XML, SWIFT, X12, HIPAA, EDIFACT, IDOC,HL7 parsers and emitters.
3. XSD , DTD parsers and validators.
4. Function and expression builders.
5. EBusiness meta data builder and library.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
1. GoXMLTransform: XML to EDI and EDI to XML Transformation Tool.

.Designed and implemented the core transformation components for X12, HIPAA, EDIFACT, SWIFT, IDOC document types.
.Responsible for refactoring and performance tuning.
.Keywords: Java, XML, EDI, Transformation, profiling, refactoring, UML, etc.


2. StremStore V2.0: Fully Transactional Native XML Database Engine. 

.Redesigned and implemented a transactional, embeddable and self-recoverable kernel for the native XML Database for Java objects and stream storage.
.Designed and implemented XML Schema parser
.Keywords: Transaction processing, Java, XML, XML Schema, UML, Database engine design, XQuery, XPath, Indexing



3. International B2B Net Market  

.Participated in an international B2B Newmarket project as a technical lead.
.Designed the database and implemented B2B Net Market application.
.Keywords: Oracle, WebLogic, Sun Solaris, Java, J2EE, JDBC, XML, Tomcat, HTML, JavaScript
